task_summary: Customer requests full cancellation of order ORD-6003. The agent should follow the cancellation policy, provide a preview of the cancellation, obtain confirmation, and then process the cancellation for eligible items.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the cancellation policy before using cancel_order.
Agent must make a cancel_order preview tool call for order ORD-6003 with confirm false or omitted before making the confirm=true cancel_order tool call.

opening_message: I would like to cancel order ORD-6003. Please cancel the entire order, which includes the SoundMax Wireless Headphones and the 7-Port USB-C Hub.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You want to cancel the entire order ORD-6003, which contains SoundMax Wireless Headphones and a 7-Port USB-C Hub. If the agent presents a valid cancellation preview and asks for confirmation, you will agree to proceed.
